steps.en: Install the editor and the CLI
Open the .fig file you exported from Figma
steps.zh: 打开你从 Figma 导出的 .fig 文件

steps.en: Decodes it on your machine and paints an editable canvas
steps.zh: 在本机把它解成节点树，画出可编辑画布

steps.en: Press the shortcut and describe the change you want
steps.zh: 按快捷键，用一句话说要改什么

steps.en: Its tool registry creates and edits nodes on the scene graph
steps.zh: 工具集在场景图上创建和修改节点

steps.en: Writes Tailwind JSX, or saves the edit back into the .fig
steps.zh: 输出 Tailwind JSX，或把改动写回 .fig

value.en: The design file stays a local file you can script: no Figma session, no upload
value.zh: 设计稿始终是你能脚本化的本地文件：不用开 Figma，也不用上传
